articles.author: Zachary Cohen, Jim Sciutto, Tal Shalev
articles.title: US has plans for major Iran strikes if Trump chooses - CNN
articles.description: US forces in the Middle East are prepared to launch new, potentially major, military operations against Iran “within 96 hours of receiving” an order from President Donald Trump, according to two US officials.
